preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
Each query K is between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: n == 0 or (n > 0 and all(digit in '0123456789' for digit in str(n)))
postconditions.description: The output n is a non-negative integer with digits in the range 0-9.

postconditions.expression: n == 0 or (n > 0 and sum(prod(s) for s in generate_subsequence_products(str(n))) % 2 == 0)
postconditions.description: The output n is the K-th magical number, where the sum of products of all non-empty subsequences of its digits is even.
